classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read by the separate `_prefetch` multiprocessing.Process which fills a depth-8 queue ahead of the main loop's compute sleep, so each tile file is read once and the read is overlapped rather than waited on by the job.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: in the main loop each iteration calls `probe.read_staged(path_for(...,"masks",i,...))` once and times it as `gated`/`masks_stall_ns` before the compute sleep, so the reading rank stalls on that single read while no other rank is held at a barrier.
